## Dictation only
- **New mode for people who only want to dictate.** It hides Chat, meetings, Dictate Prompt, Read Aloud and the other features. Nothing is deleted, and the switch in Settings → General brings everything back.
- **Its own welcome tour.** The first screen asks how you want to use WhisperShortcut. "Dictation only" sets up offline dictation with spoken punctuation, downloads the speech model right away and walks you through a short test dictation and your first Glossary word.
- Leaving the mode restores the settings the tour changed.

## Dictation
- **Your own instructions instead of a replaced prompt.** The Dictation and Dictate Prompt settings now hold only what you want to add; the built-in instructions stay in place and keep getting better with updates. Existing custom prompts keep working and can be converted with one click.
- **Glossary starter lists:** add German specialist terms for orthopedics, psychiatry/psychotherapy or expert reports in one click (Settings → Dictate).
- Offline dictation with a Glossary changes fewer words wrongly: "kein Metoprolol" keeps its "kein", opposite prefixes are no longer swapped, and real mishearings such as "Rötenbild" → "Röntgenbild" are now corrected.
- Dictate Live with spoken punctuation splits a "punkt" glued to the end of a word into the word and a full stop, while real words like "Treffpunkt" stay.

## Chat
- **"Always allow"** for creating and changing calendar events, tasks and Trello cards. Deletions and other actions still ask every time. Settings → Accounts lists what you allowed, with Remove.

## Installation
Download the DMG from the [releases page](https://github.com/mgsgde/whisper-shortcut/releases), open it, and drag WhisperShortcut to your Applications folder.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/mgsgde/whisper-shortcut/compare/v8.91...v8.92
